title: codiaeum variegatum var. ovalifolium
intro: Codiaeum variegatum var. ovalifolium, commonly known as the Gold Dust Crape Myrtle or Malay Gold, is a variety of the Codiaeum variegatum plant, which is a species of flowering plant in the family Euphorbiaceae. This plant is native to the tropical regions of Asia and is valued for its attractive, variegated leaves and vibrant yellow flowers. The health benefits of the Gold Dust Crape Myrtle include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing due to its antimicrobial and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal effects.
